from_quote: the trial of all crimes, except in cases of impeachment, shall be by jury
rationale: The paragraph reproduces, as what "in the new system, it is provided", the words of Article III, Section 2, Clause 3 on jury trial of crimes.
to_quote: The Trial of all Crimes, except in Cases of Impeachment, shall be by Jury

from_quote: The new government is to have the power of protecting literary property
rationale: The paragraph names the new government's "power of protecting literary property", which only the clause on securing to authors the right to their writings fits.

from_quote: The powers now to be committed to the national legislature, as they are detailed in the 8th section of the first article
rationale: The paragraph refers by number to "the 8th section of the first article" as a whole.

from_quote: except those which are contained in the first paragraph of that section
rationale: The paragraph refers by number to "the first paragraph" of the eighth section of the first article.

from_quote: it is that between a Foreigner and a Citizen, or that between the Citizens of different States
rationale: Discussing the objects to be submitted to the national judiciary, the paragraph names the cases between a foreigner and a citizen and between citizens of different states, echoing the list of controversies in Article III, Section 2, Clause 1.

from_quote: with such exceptions, and under such regulations as Congress shall make
rationale: The paragraph reproduces, of the appeals to the national courts, the words of the appellate-jurisdiction clause of Article III, Section 2 (leaving out "the" before "Congress").
to_quote: with such Exceptions, and under such Regulations as the Congress shall make

from_quote: It is provided in this system, that there shall be no fraudulent tender in the payments of debts.
rationale: The paragraph names the provision "in this system" on tenders "in the payments of debts", echoing the words of Article I, Section 10, Clause 1.
to_quote: a Tender in Payment of Debts

from_quote: It is now provided, that no appropriation of money for the use of the army shall be for a longer time than two years.
rationale: The paragraph closely paraphrases, as what "is now provided", the limit on army appropriations in the clause on raising and supporting armies.
to_quote: no Appropriation of Money to that Use shall be for a longer Term than two Years

from_quote: the Congress, by a majority of votes, is to have the power to regulate trade
rationale: The paragraph names Congress's "power to regulate trade" ("commerce") under the new system, which only the commerce clause fits.

from_quote: the several states are not permitted to tax their exports for the benefit of their particular treasuries
rationale: The paragraph names the restriction on the states' taxing their exports for their own treasuries, which only Article I, Section 10, Clause 2 fits.

from_quote: No duties will be laid on exports
rationale: Describing the proposed form of government, the paragraph names the rule that no duties will be laid on exports, which only Article I, Section 9, Clause 5 fits.

from_quote: If excises are laid on wine, spirits, or other luxuries, they must be uniform throughout the states.
rationale: The paragraph names the requirement that excises be "uniform throughout the states", echoing the uniformity rule in Article I, Section 8, Clause 1.
to_quote: shall be uniform throughout the United States
